name: Barbarian audit: Ogre's Endurance raises healing received natively (#2566)
contract: #2566 Ogre's Endurance (705206) covers only its effect 0, SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT (118, EffectBasePoints 10 DieSides 0 -> amount 10, MiscValue 127 = all schools) -- a stock generic percentage-healing-taken modifier consumed inside Unit::SpellHealingBonusTaken (the spell_healing_taken metric calls this directly with a synthetic 1000-point heal from probe spell 2050). Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_DUMMY (4, EffectBasePoints 0) with no numeric payload and is explicitly out of scope for this scenario -- it is covered separately by the agent handling this audit's dummy/proc-trigger effects.
